# 2 Baruch Chapter 4 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**4:1** And the Lord said to me: "This city shall be delivered up for a season, and the people shall be chastened for a season, and the world shall not be forgotten.

**4:2** Do you think that this is the city of which I said: 'Upon the palms of my hands have I engraved you'? Not this building that is now in your midst is the true one; it is that which shall be revealed with me, that which was prepared beforehand here from the time when I took counsel to make Paradise.

**4:3** And I showed it to Adam before he sinned; but when he transgressed the commandment, it was removed from him, as also Paradise.

**4:4** And after these things I showed it to my servant Abraham in the night between the portions of the sacrifices.

**4:5** And again also I showed it to Moses on Mount Sinai when I showed him the likeness of the tabernacle and all its vessels.

**4:6** And now, behold it is preserved with me, as also Paradise, and shall be revealed with me and shall come to pass at that hour when my Anointed One begins to be revealed.

**4:7** Therefore be not dismayed regarding this, for what now is happening comes not from your sins but is preparation for what is to come."

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS base throughout. "Anointed One" preferred over PNEUMA's "Messiah" — the Syriac meshiha is more precisely rendered with the full title in an apocalyptic context. "Likeness of the tabernacle" (v.5) retained; PNEUMA's "pattern" is acceptable but "likeness" is more theologically precise for the heavenly-earthly correspondence.*
